primary_finding.evidence: wacom_wireless_work (2511): usbdev != NULL is the only guard (2528); hdev1 = usb_get_intfdata(usbdev->config->interface[1]) (2532), hdev2 = usb_get_intfdata(usbdev->config->interface[2]) (2538); no bNumInterfaces check anywhere in wacom_sys.c/wacom_wac.c (grep exit 1). Trigger: wacom_wireless_irq (wacom_wac.c:3370) on device-supplied WACOM_PKGLEN_WIRELESS report with data[1]&0x01 and changed pid -> wacom_schedule_work(WACOM_WORKER_WIRELESS) (3396/3405) -> schedule_work(&wacom->wireless_work) (wacom.h:191-192). usbdev set only when hid_is_usb (wacom_sys.c:2860-2863). NULL/garbage interface[1]/[2] then usb_get_intfdata -> usb_get_intfdata dereferences intf->dev? Need to confirm usb_get_intfdata deref chain: usb_get_intfdata(intf) = dev_get_drvdata(&intf->dev) -> dereferences &intf->dev => NULL+offsetof deref if interface[1] is NULL.

candidates.evidence: snd_usb_create_streams: host_iface = &usb_ifnum_to_if(dev, ctrlif)->altsetting[0] at 339 has no visible NULL check in this function, BUT ctrlif comes from snd_usb_probe's ifnum = interface->altsetting[0].desc.bInterfaceNumber of the bound interface (the interface usbcore handed to probe), so usb_ifnum_to_if(dev, ctrlif) returns that same non-NULL interface; UAC1 h1->baInterfaceNr[i] loop feeds snd_usb_create_stream which NULL-checks usb_ifnum_to_if (253-259); UAC2/3 IAD assoc->bFirstInterface+i loop likewise goes through the NULL-checked snd_usb_create_stream; ctrlif+1 fallback at 409 is NULL-checked.
snd_usb_create_stream NULL-checks usb_ifnum_to_if(dev, interface) at 255-259 before altsetting[0] use at 261; Android quirk re-lookup at 274-276 also NULL-checked.

snd_usb_add_ctrl_interface_link: host_iface = &usb_ifnum_to_if(dev, ctrlif)->altsetting[0] at 145 without local NULL check, but ctrlif is the probed interface's own ifnum (card.c:1031 snd_usb_create_streams(chip, ifnum) where ifnum = the interface passed to probe), so lookup cannot fail; every other caller path NULL-checks before alt use.

probe requires intf->num_altsetting == 3 (686-688) before usb_set_interface(...,2) (690), then re-reads intf->cur_altsetting and checks bNumEndpoints < 2 (694-695) before endpoint use; alt switch itself is core-validated.
ttusb_dec_set_interface uses literal altnums 0/8/1 only via usb_set_interface (901/908/911) which usbcore validates against the parsed descriptor set; no direct altsetting[] indexing in the driver.
ttusb_setup_interfaces only calls usb_set_interface(dev, 1, 1) (918) with hardcoded pipes (1/1/2), not descriptor-array indexing; core validates altnum; pipes are ep addresses not array indexes.
btusb_find_altsetting loops i < intf->num_altsetting comparing altsetting[i].desc.bAlternateSetting == alt before returning &intf->altsetting[i]; loop-bounded and NULL-checks data->isoc.

ch9_postconfig loops i < iface->num_altsetting, takes alt from altsetting[i].desc.bAlternateSetting, and set_altsetting() -> usb_set_interface is core-validated; usbtest is also a testing driver not normally bound to arbitrary devices.
xhci_get_timeout_no_hub_lpm loops i < config->desc.bNumInterfaces with NULL check on config->interface[i]; loop-bounded by the same count that sized the array.
find_last_interface loops i < config->desc.bNumInterfaces over config->interface[i]; loop-bounded.

intf_cache[0]->altsetting[1] in stv06xx_isoc_nego relies on stv06xx_isoc_init's num_altsetting<2 (318) and bNumEndpoints<1 (324) checks via gspca core ordering (isoc_init at gspca.c:774 runs before any isoc_nego at 882); altsetting-count half guarded, endpoint half owned by media-epidx (f035).
Same isoc_init-guards-isoc_nego ordering; cit_isoc_init checks num_altsetting<2 at 2650 and bNumEndpoints<1 at 2656 before its altsetting[1] write at 2659.
